newsitem.title: USA: Ascend launches new switching system.
newsitem.headline: Ascend launches new switching system.

text.p: Ascend Communications Inc on Tuesday unveiled a new wide area network switching system, called the MAX TNT, offering a united platform for dial-up and dedicated traffic.
Prices for the MAX TNT start at $18,750 and the product is available immediately, Ascend said.

Ascend said the MAX TNT is the first system that gives service providers the ability to support 2,000 simultaneous modem users, or 4,000 ISDN, or 56/64 Kbps frame relay connections in a single eight-foot rack.
It also is the only WAN access switch capable of terminating up to 150 T1/FT1 frame relay connections in a single 14-inch shelf, according to Ascend.
"The number of concurrent sessions we support in the MAX TNT is a major leap beyond what any other vendor can deliver," said Bernie Schneider, Ascend's vice president, strategic business development.
